title: C418Mania!
description: This is a resource pack that replaces all the ambient music composed by Lena Raine, Kumi Tanioka, Samuel Aberg, Aaron Cherof, Amos Roddy and Fingerspit with many of c418's tracks from his many albums.
body:
This is a resource pack that replaces all the ambient music composed by Lena Raine, Kumi Tanioka, Samuel Aberg, Aaron Cherof, Amos Roddy and Fingerspit with many of c418's tracks from his many albums.

It doesn't replace any of the new records added to the game (Since I feel like records are the better way of introducing the other artists music without being disrupting.)

It was originally named "Caves and cliffs music replacement pack" but I left it without updates for years, now it is complete up to the latest tracks released in ver 26.1.1, and it should work up to ver 1.19.2. 

I own none of the music and all of the rights go to C418.
